## DNA extraction

```{r data_dna_extraction, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
dna_extraction <- read_excel("data/dna_extraction.xlsx")

dna_extraction_df<-dna_extraction %>%
  #pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata,by=join_by(sample==Tube_code))
```

```{r data_dna_extraction_model, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# DNA yield (Qubit, ng/ul) ~ time point (reference = Acclimation) + (1 | individual).
# Estimate "time_point.xAntibiotics" = Antibiotics - Acclimation (a negative estimate is a LOWER DNA yield after antibiotics).
# Manuscript statement: "lower DNA extraction yields (LMM ...)".
# Two samples (AC85, AD31) have no match in the sample metadata and are dropped by the model (lmer na.action).
model_dna<- lmerTest::lmer(dna_extraction ~ time_point.x+(1|individual), data = dna_extraction_df)
summary(model_dna)
cat("\nDNA yield: samples used =", nobs(model_dna), ", individuals =", lme4::ngrps(model_dna), "\n")
cat("Mean DNA yield by time point:\n")
dna_extraction_df %>% filter(!is.na(individual)) %>% group_by(time_point.x) %>% summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(dna_extraction), sd = sd(dna_extraction)) %>% print()
summary(model_dna)$coefficients["time_point.xAntibiotics", ] %>% signif(4) %>% print()
```

## Bacterial fraction change

```{r data_bacterial_fraction, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
mag_fragtion_accli_antib<-data_stats %>%
  mutate(
    unmapped_reads = trimmed_reads - mapped_lizard - mapped_mags,
    mag_proportion = mapped_mags / (mapped_mags + unmapped_reads),
    singlem_read_fraction = singlem_read_fraction
  ) %>%
  select(sample, mag_proportion, singlem_read_fraction) %>%
  mutate(
    mag_proportion = if_else(singlem_read_fraction == 0, 0, mag_proportion),
    singlem_read_fraction = if_else(singlem_read_fraction == 0, NA, singlem_read_fraction),
    singlem_read_fraction = if_else(singlem_read_fraction < mag_proportion, NA, singlem_read_fraction),
    singlem_read_fraction = if_else(singlem_read_fraction > 1, 1, singlem_read_fraction)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "proportion", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = factor(
      proportion,
      levels = c("mag_proportion", "singlem_read_fraction")
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_point))%>%
  filter(time_point %in% c("Acclimation", "Antibiotics") & proportion=="mag_proportion")
```

```{r data_bacterial_fraction_model, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# NOTE: this model is for the fraction of non-host reads that map to the MAG catalogue (mag_proportion = mapped_mags / (mapped_mags + unmapped non-host reads)),
# i.e. the recovered MICROBIAL fraction, NOT the host fraction. It decreases after antibiotics (negative estimate).
# The host DNA fraction is modelled in the next chunk (data_host_fraction_model).
model_fraction<- lmerTest::lmer(value ~ time_point+(1|individual), data = mag_fragtion_accli_antib)
summary(model_fraction)
```

```{r data_host_fraction_model, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Host DNA fraction = reads mapped to the lizard genome / quality-filtered (trimmed) reads.
# Model: fraction ~ time point (reference = Acclimation) + (1 | individual).
# Estimate "time_pointAntibiotics" = Antibiotics - Acclimation (positive = HIGHER relative host DNA after antibiotics).
# Manuscript statement: "higher relative fraction of host DNA in faeces (LMM ...)".
host_fraction_df <- data_stats %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point %in% c("Acclimation", "Antibiotics")) %>%
  mutate(host_fraction = mapped_lizard / trimmed_reads,
         mag_fraction_of_trimmed = mapped_mags / trimmed_reads)

host_fraction_df %>%
  group_by(time_point) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), host_fraction_mean = mean(host_fraction), host_fraction_sd = sd(host_fraction),
            mag_proportion_mean = mean(mag_fraction_of_trimmed)) %>%
  print()

model_host_fraction <- lmerTest::lmer(host_fraction ~ time_point + (1 | individual), data = host_fraction_df)
summary(model_host_fraction)
cat("\nHost fraction: samples used =", nobs(model_host_fraction), ", individuals =", lme4::ngrps(model_host_fraction), "\n")
summary(model_host_fraction)$coefficients["time_pointAntibiotics", ] %>% signif(4) %>% print()
```

### Contrasts within species (Antibiotics - Acclimation)
```{r alpha_antibiotics_contrasts, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Post-hoc contrasts of the time_point x species models above (emmeans), Antibiotics - Acclimation within each species.
# Negative estimate = lower diversity after antibiotics. Richness (glmer.nb) is on the log (link) scale; neutral and phylogenetic (lme) on the response scale.
# Manuscript (P. muralis): richness est = -1.152, p = 6.02e-10; neutral est = -11.463, p = 6e-04; phylogenetic est = -0.761, p = 0.221.
contrast_table <- function(model, metric) {
  emmeans::emmeans(model, ~ time_point | species) %>%
    emmeans::contrast(method = "revpairwise") %>%   # reference level order: Antibiotics - Acclimation
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(metric = metric, .before = 1)
}
alpha_contrasts <- bind_rows(
  contrast_table(Modelq0GLMMNB, "richness (log scale)"),
  contrast_table(Model_neutral, "neutral"),
  contrast_table(Model_phylo, "phylogenetic"))
alpha_contrasts %>% print()
alpha_contrasts %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4))) %>%
  tt()
```

```{r dispersion_helper_antib, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
# Homogeneity of multivariate dispersion: betadisper + permutest, 9,999 permutations, set.seed(123).
# Identical to supplementary_tables/table_S10_dispersion.R (same sample order, seed and call).
disp_test <- function(beta_obj, meta, group) {
  M <- as.matrix(beta_obj$S)
  ids <- meta$Tube_code[meta$Tube_code %in% rownames(M)]
  d <- as.dist(M[ids, ids])
  dat <- meta[match(labels(d), meta$Tube_code), ]
  set.seed(123)
  permutest(betadisper(d, factor(dat[[group]])), pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 9999)
}
```

```{r permanova_richness_adonis, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# NOTE: with strata = individual (and species constant within individual) this block CANNOT test `species`
# (a between-individual term); only time_point and the interaction are meaningful, and the interaction is not
# fully valid under raw-data permutations. The manuscript cites only the Antibiotics-only block further below.
# The species effect is tested in the whole-plot chunk after the three blocks (permuting species labels across individuals).
set.seed(123)
adonis2(richness ~ time_point*species,
        data = subset_meta %>% arrange(match(Tube_code,labels(richness))),
        permutations = 9999,
        strata = subset_meta %>% arrange(match(Tube_code,labels(richness))) %>% pull(individual),
        by="terms") %>%
        broom::tidy() %>%
        tt()
```

### Whole-plot test of species (Acclimation + Antibiotics, repeated measures)
```{r wholeplot_species_acc_antib, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Between-individual `species` effect after time_point: species labels are permuted across individuals (whole plots),
# each individual keeping both of its time points. Euclidean embedding of the distances (positive eigenvalues only).
wholeplot_species_test <- function(d, meta, nperm = 9999) {
  meta <- as.data.frame(meta)[match(labels(d), meta$Tube_code), ]
  pc <- suppressWarnings(cmdscale(d, k = attr(d, "Size") - 1, eig = TRUE))
  Y <- pc$points[, pc$eig[seq_len(ncol(pc$points))] > 1e-8, drop = FALSE]; n <- nrow(Y)
  ind <- factor(meta$individual); sp <- factor(meta$species)
  ind_sp <- sp[match(levels(ind), meta$individual)]
  Xt <- model.matrix(~ time_point, meta)
  rss <- function(X) sum(qr.resid(qr(X), Y)^2)
  Fsp <- function(s) {
    X1 <- cbind(Xt, model.matrix(~ s[as.integer(ind)])[, -1, drop = FALSE])
    r0 <- rss(Xt); r1 <- rss(X1); ((r0 - r1) / (ncol(X1) - ncol(Xt))) / (r1 / (n - ncol(X1)))
  }
  F_obs <- Fsp(ind_sp); set.seed(123)
  Fp <- replicate(nperm, Fsp(sample(ind_sp)))
  tibble(test = "Whole-plot species (after time_point)", n = n, n_individuals = nlevels(ind),
         F = F_obs, p = (1 + sum(Fp >= F_obs - 1e-12)) / (1 + nperm))
}
bind_rows(Richness = wholeplot_species_test(richness, subset_meta),
          Neutral = wholeplot_species_test(neutral, subset_meta),
          Phylogenetic = wholeplot_species_test(phylo, subset_meta), .id = "metric") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4))) %>% tt()
```

```{r shapiro_antib_1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
```

```{r data_filter1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
samples_to_keep <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(time_point == "Antibiotics") %>% 
  select(Tube_code) %>% 
  pull()
subset_meta <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(time_point == "Antibiotics")
```

### Richness
```{r permanova_rich1, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
richness <- as.matrix(beta_q0n$S)
richness <- as.dist(richness[rownames(richness) %in% samples_to_keep,
               colnames(richness) %in% samples_to_keep])

disp_test(beta_q0n, subset_meta, "species")
```

```{r permanova_rich1_adonis, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
adonis2(richness ~ species,
        data = subset_meta %>% arrange(match(Tube_code,labels(richness))),
        permutations = 9999) %>%
        broom::tidy() %>%
        tt()
```

```{r betad_div_plot, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
richness %>%
  metaMDS(.,trymax = 500, k=2, verbosity=FALSE, trace=FALSE) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(subset_meta, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  group_by(species, time_point) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2, color=species)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#d57d2c",'#008080')) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=x_cen, y=y_cen, xend=NMDS1, yend=NMDS2), alpha=0.2) +
  labs(y = "NMDS2", x="NMDS1 \n Richness beta diversity") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme()

neutral %>%
  metaMDS(.,trymax = 500, k=2, verbosity=FALSE, trace=FALSE) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(subset_meta, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code))%>%
  group_by(species, time_point) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2, color=species)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#d57d2c",'#008080')) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=x_cen, y=y_cen, xend=NMDS1, yend=NMDS2), alpha=0.2) +
  labs(y = "NMDS2", x = "NMDS1 \n Neutral beta diversity") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme()

phylo %>%

  labs(y= element_blank (),x="NMDS1 \n Phylogenetic beta diversity") +
```
